$description: [Brand] colors and type. Only change the text inside the quotes; keep the quotes and commas. Replace each [#000000] with your hex code and drop the brackets, like "#B5532B". Don't know your hex codes? Ask your designer, or look in your website builder's color settings. Values marked Optional can stay as they are.

primary.$description: [where it's used, e.g. the one main button]

chart.$description: Optional. Colors for charts and graphs, in order of use.

fallback.$description: Used when the brand fonts aren't installed, e.g. in Google Slides

space.$description: Optional. Spacing steps in pixels. Leave as is if you're not sure.

radius.$description: Optional. How round corners are on buttons and cards. 0px means square.

banned_colors.$description: Colors the AI must never use, e.g. a competitor's or an old brand color. None? Change the list to [] and don't delete anything.
